name: Súr (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Súr (a red and blue shield with a stag, a patriarchal cross and a wavy stripe) within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed SÚR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Súr arms with wreath and scroll
